title: Measured 2-SAT branching for 3-CNF with few ternary clauses
claims: LogarithmicThreeClauseSAT gives a P language agreeing with satisfiability on canonical 3-CNFs whose ternary branching space fits the explicit polynomial budget.
CNFThreeClausePacking implements exact polynomial-time partition of canonical 3-CNF into its small-clause base and ternary groups.
ThreeClauseBranching2SAT checks deterministic decision on canonical packed mixed formulae under the explicit budget.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
